title: pm: add a line-ratchet ceiling for root CLAUDE.md
body:
Fixes #9965

Adds a `CEILINGS` row for root `CLAUDE.md` to `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`, per the maintainer ruling recorded on the card (2026-08-20), verbatim and untranslated: 「其他接受你的建议。」 Rationale on record: `CLAUDE.md` is structurally growth-prone — it exists to inline the rules that must never be missed, so every new must-never-miss rule is an argument for appending to it — and a one-line ceiling now prevents compound growth cheaply.

Ceiling set at the measured count on `origin/main`, **86**, headroom 0 — the map's standing convention. Measured with the gate's own `countLines` (not `wc -l`; both agree here at 86).

## File surface

`scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` only. The covered file `CLAUDE.md` is deliberately **not** touched by this PR — the dispatch pinned that, and `git status` for it is empty at every point below.

Explicitly out of this landing, per the ruling: the sibling-repo question (objectui/cloud root instruction files, unreachable from this ratchet). That stays a separate carve if the seat wants it. `#9965` is the only card this PR closes.

## The four coupled edits, all inside that one file

1. **The `CEILINGS` row** — `['CLAUDE.md', 86]`, with the ruling quoted in place as provenance.
2. **The header's boundary sentence.** It read that `.claude/hooks/`, `.claude/settings.json` and `CLAUDE.md` "carry no ceiling either". Adding the row makes that false, so it is corrected in the same commit, and the coverage enumeration above it now names both root instruction files. A ratchet whose header contradicts its own map is precisely the finding class this lane keeps filing.
3. **`ROOT_FILE_WATCH_HINTS` gains `'CLAUDE.md/**'`** — this is *mechanically forced*, not scope creep. The pre-existing self-test case `every separator-less ceiling declares a root-file watch hint` goes red for any separator-less `CEILINGS` key without a matching hint. The spelling matches what `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs` already uses for these same two root files (`['AGENTS.md/**', 'CLAUDE.md/**']`). Its docblock prose ("covers exactly one file", and a present-tense claim that `AGENTS.md` was the only separator-less key) is corrected with it.
4. **Self-test** — a case pinning the new row, and the `AGENTS.md is the root file it declares` exclusivity case replaced with the two-file form, mirroring the sibling gate's `both-root-instruction-files-are-declared`.

## Verification

All readings taken at the final commit, `411b950`.

**The ceiling bites** — throwaway ablation, never committed, trap-guarded (`trap … EXIT INT TERM`) so a foreground-cap SIGTERM mid-mutation could not leave the tree mutated. The mutation was confirmed **on disk** rather than trusted to an editor exit code: marker `grep -c` 0 → 1, gate-convention line count 86 → 87, sha256 changed.

Red leg, the gate's own verdict line:

```
✗ check-skill-line-ratchet: CLAUDE.md is 87 lines; the ratchet ceiling is 86. Keep the surface
compressed: … Raising a ceiling requires a maintainer ruling quoted in the PR.
```

(process exit 1)

Restore proved byte-identical — `sha256` back to `03749199…c57b91d2`, marker count back to 0, `git status --porcelain CLAUDE.md` empty. Green leg:

```
✓ check-skill-line-ratchet: CLAUDE.md is 86 lines (ceiling 86; headroom 0).
```

**Gate union.** Families derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` against the actual change set (it read `1 path(s) vs merge base 6a4e929f5`, working tree) — seven families, all run, all green, plus `check:nul-bytes`:

| gate | verdict |
| --- | --- |
| `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` | `✓ … self-test: 20 cases pass.` · 21 ceiling rows green |
| `pnpm check:cross-package-test-inputs` | `OK: 14 package(s) read outside themselves, all declared…` |
| `pnpm check:entry-guard` | `✓ check:entry-guard: 137 scripts/ file(s) — every entry guard goes through invoked-as.mjs…` |
| `pnpm check:parse-guard` | `All 104 self-test cases passed.` |
| `pnpm check:pnpm-filter-targets` | `✓ check:pnpm-filter-targets: 121/149 --filter occurrence(s) … resolve` |
| `node scripts/check-ci-filter-parity.mjs` | `OK: all 88 declared cross-package glob(s) (76 unique) are covered…` |
| `node scripts/check-cross-package-test-inputs.mjs` | `OK: 14 package(s) read outside themselves, all declared…` |
| `pnpm check:nul-bytes` | `check-nul-bytes: OK (scanned 6330 text file(s) … no raw ASCII control bytes)` |

**The watch hint measured, not asserted.** A hypothetical `CLAUDE.md` card derived 1 family before this change and 2 after — exactly the one (gate, file) pair the docblock claims per root file:

```
before:  - pnpm check:pm-governed-merges   matched via CLAUDE.md ⇢ gate source 'CLAUDE.md/**'
after:   - pnpm check:pm-governed-merges   matched via CLAUDE.md ⇢ gate source 'CLAUDE.md/**'
         - pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet     matched via CLAUDE.md ⇢ gate source 'CLAUDE.md/**'
```

Before this, a card editing `CLAUDE.md` derived no ratchet at all and would have met the new ceiling as red CI instead of as a local command.

## Governed-merges reading, and a discrepancy worth the reviewer's eye

`node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --test scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`, verdict line verbatim:

```
governed-surface predicate: 0 of 1 path(s) hit the register (5 surfaces, repo-agnostic).
  ✅  NOT governed — ordinary queue landing applies to a PR with exactly this file list.
```

This **disagrees with the ruling comment's prose**, which called the landing a "Governed surface (`scripts/pm/` ratchet + the covered file)". The register governs `docs/adr/**`, `.claude/**`, `skills/**`, `AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md` — not `scripts/pm/**`. The *covered file* is governed; the *ratchet script* is not, and this PR touches only the script.

**The PR is kept draft regardless**, per the card's recorded constraint (draft-only, human merge, contract-review tier at ACCEPT) — the recorded constraint wins over the machine reading, and the PM reconciles the discrepancy at ACCEPT. No auto-merge armed, never flipped ready.

## Changeset

None — scripts-only, releases nothing user-visible. Carrying `skip-changeset` per this repo's convention (the label is a real mechanism here, applied additively and read back after the size-labeler settles).
